item.title: Protestors in Norway Will Stay in Quarantine - The Nordic Page
item.description: Some municipalities and companies in Norway require their employees to stay in quarantine, if they pariticpated in the police violence in USA protests on Friday.

item.title: Hunger Strike to Stop Wind Turbines in Northwest Norway - The Nordic Page
item.description: Kari Thue starts hunger strike outside the Viken county's premises in Oslo to protest of the wind turbine construction on Haramsøy, Norway.

item.title: Norway Will Let Civilians Carry Out Police Duties - The Nordic Page
item.description: Security guards and civilians in Norway police will do prisoner transport and attend to court cases, suggest the government.

item.title: Norway provides funding for UN Migration Trust Fund - The Nordic Page
item.description: Norway is providing NOK 15 million to the UN start-up funding for safe, orderly and regular migration, the Migration Multi-Partner Trust Fund

item.title: Norway opens the borders for Europe on 15 July - The Nordic Page
item.description: Norway lifts entry restrictions for EEA countries from 15 July, if the Corona situation in the country is under control for quarantine-free travel.

item.title: Worrying Trend in Norway: Young People Have the Highest Corona Infection Rate - The Nordic Page
item.description: New figures from the Norwegian Institute of Public Health (FHI) show that most new cases of corona infection in Norway are among young people between the ages of 20 and 29.

item.title: Norway Postal Service Becomes the World's First To Use Electric Trucks - The Nordic Page
item.description: From 2021, Norway postal service, Posten will use the world's first purpose-built, fully-electric 16-ton trucks for delivery.

item.title: Reserachers in Norway Study Connection between Sunbathing and Corona Infection - The Nordic Page
item.description: Researchers in Norway investigate whether sun and fish can have an effect on corona infection, according to NRK.
